title: Replace demo interactive loop with safe typed command loop
purpose: Turn --tui-interactive into a real operator loop backed by typed commands and durable runtime state.
scope: Accept only typed TUI commands defined by the grammar.
Route each command to TuiRuntimeController or read-only projection handlers.
Render updated snapshot after each accepted command.
acceptance_criteria: --tui-interactive can create a durable run from an intent.
Unknown or shell-like input is rejected with typed help, not executed.
Interactive loop can render dashboard, run, approvals, recovery and audit views.
Demo mode is explicit and cannot be confused with durable mode.
failure_modes: --tui-interactive still builds only a suspended demo session.
Interactive loop hides command errors or runtime path errors.
